coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the character box. Drawn rule: x extent, y1 = bottom of the rule, y0 = y1 - 10.
how_measured: pdfplumber characters and thin filled rectangles; the HTML source read where a rule's purpose was unclear; every page looked at at 100 dpi; overlays looked at.

signing.kind: The subscriber signs the agreement (page 7) with its details running onto page 8, the company accepts on page 9, and the subscriber initials the accredited categories and signs the questionnaire (pages 10-11) in an entity block or an individual block.

sure_per_page.1: sure (one judgement: the price-per-share blank is kept as the subscriber's)

1: the double rule under the browser header line (y 60) and the page-end frames on every page (white box with a black outline, about y 520-570)
7: the underline of the heading "DELIVERY AND REGISTRATION INSTRUCTIONS" (y 294)
8: the country rule (y 143): already filled in with "United States of America"
11: the full-width rule under the request for equity owners' details (y 268): an <hr> separator in the source, no room to write (the details go on a separate sheet)
